title: Duration report: an empty or wrong-shape Node event artifact reads as a measured zero-test report
outcome: In scripts/test-durations.mjs the Node JSONL parser checks JSON syntax but not event shape or completeness. An empty artifact, or lines such as `{}`, is therefore reported as status "measured" with zero tests. A reporter that created its file and died before emitting events looks like a valid zero-test run. The fix validates the recognized event shapes and reports an empty or incomplete event stream as unreadable or incomplete, not as a measurement. It adds empty and wrong-shape Node artifact cases.
acceptance: An empty, structurally invalid or incomplete Node duration artifact is reported as unreadable or incomplete rather than a measured zero-test report; tests cover the empty and wrong-shape cases.
